title: Business Central Trivia Recap: November 16–20, 2026
summary: Business Central Trivia event held November 16-20, 2026 with 250 questions and 1,398 answers showing 52% correct rate. Development and Navigation categories presented the highest and lowest difficulty levels respectively.
key_points: Event ran five days with 50 questions per day and 1,398 total answers submitted
Overall accuracy was 52 percent, matching the previous week's rate
Development category was hardest with 28 percent correct answers
Navigation and User Interface was easiest with 75 percent correct answers
Keyboard Shortcuts improved dramatically from 37 percent to 73 percent correct

quotes.text: Development was the hardest category again, and Navigation and User Interface was the easiest again.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows consistent difficulty patterns across trivia rounds, helping identify areas where users struggle most

quotes.text: 52 percent of the answers were correct, the same as last week.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates steady community engagement and consistent knowledge levels across weekly trivia events
